expected.tolerance_basis: Formula-identity check, not a measurement: Grober (2011) gives mu_r = v_release^2 / (2 g S); the value is that closed form evaluated from the listed inputs (v_release = 1.83 m/s per Holmes via Grober p.6, standard gravity, S = 10 ft). The relative tolerance only absorbs floating-point representation.

source.citation: R. D. Grober, "The Geometry of Putting on a Planar Surface," arXiv:1106.1698 (2011), Appendix A, p.7.
source.locator: arXiv:1106.1698v1, p.7, drag-force / Stimp-distance derivation (PDF downloaded and read directly, not a search summary).

expected.tolerance_basis: Grober (2011, p.6) directly quotes Holmes' corrected Stimpmeter release speed as 6.0 ft/s = 1.8288 m/s; +/-0.005 m/s covers the ft/s -> m/s rounding to 1.83. The underlying Holmes 'Dialogue concerning the Stimpmeter' (Physics Teacher) attribution is itself a secondary citation inside Grober's paper and was not independently located, so this fixture is marked unverified despite the number being read directly.

source.citation: R. D. Grober, arXiv:1106.1698 (2011), p.6, citing B. W. Holmes, "Dialogue concerning the Stimpmeter," The Physics Teacher (full volume/year not recovered).
source.locator: arXiv:1106.1698v1, p.6 (read directly); the Holmes Physics Teacher citation it reproduces is secondary and incomplete.
